title: Lego Creates Sony PlayStation Set
paragraphs: Lego has made a new set that looks just like the first Sony PlayStation.
Sony announced the set on September 3 during its State of Play online event. The original PlayStation game console came out in 1994. It was gray, with a lid on top to put in game discs.

The Lego set has 1,911 pieces. When it is finished, it is almost the same size as the real console. It also comes with a Lego controller that can be plugged into the front of the console, just like the real one. The buttons for "Power" and "Open" also work.

There are also some surprises inside the console. When you open it, you can find small scenes from two famous PlayStation games, Gran Turismo and Ape Escape. Gran Turismo is a car racing game, and Ape Escape is a game about catching monkeys.
The set costs $179.99 in the US. In the UK, it costs £139.99, and in Europe, it costs €159.99.

Members of the Lego Insiders program and customers of the PlayStation Direct online store could buy the set from October 1 in some countries. Everyone else could buy it from Lego stores, the Lego website and other stores from October 4.
Steffi Steffen, who works at Sony, said that Sony worked closely with Lego designers to make the set.
Lego has made many sets for adults in recent years. This new set is likely to be popular with people who played PlayStation games when they were young.
